package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for dto_to_model_mapping_in_handler: Handlers that own transport-to-model mapping instead of dedicated mappers or services.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type CreateUserRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Email    string `json:"email"`
	Age      int    `json:"age"`
}

type User struct {
	Name  string
	Email string
	Age   int
	Active bool
}

func CreateUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req CreateUserRequest
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)

	user := User{
		Name:   req.Username,
		Email:  req.Email,
		Age:    req.Age,
		Active: true,
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(user)
}
